description: HT-BTES surrogate for dispatch model. Cylindrical (hex-packed disc) field, H=200m, B=3.0m (500 bh, 100,000m total). Charges at 106C (wellhead brine, Kaufmann et al. ECM 2026), discharges directly to DH network when T_out >= 80C. ARX fitted to pygfunction 20-yr simulation; per-age-block coefficients.
model_form: T_state(h+1) = a_h*T_state(h) + b_ch_h*Qch(h) + b_dis_h*Qdis(h) + c_h  [hourly, kWh units]

fit.source: a_d=1, c_d=0 (pure accumulator, no idle dynamics); b_dis pinned to -b_ch/eta_sim per age block so the surrogate round trip equals the simulated energy ratio by construction
fit.daily_to_hourly_conversion: a_h = a_d^(1/24), b unchanged (kWh units same), c_h = c_d/24

invest.notes: IK_EUR: drilling 70 EUR/m x 500 boreholes x 200 m = 7,000,000 EUR (drilling only). Ancillaries separate. Warm-up cost set to 0.
